attributes.name: banner-graphic-role
attributes.definition: What a banner or image-based strip on the page is used for.

values.definition: Banner image used as a section/sidebar title in place of live text.
Banner promoting the site's own related products or services.
Banner advertising an external party's product or service.

attributes.name: banner-placement
attributes.definition: Where banners sit within the page structure.

values.definition: Banner is inserted as a full-width strip between content sections.

attributes.name: section-title-rendering
attributes.definition: Whether section titles are live text or baked into images.

values.definition: Titles are rasterized images with custom lettering.
